findings:
🔴 [verified-critical-gate-exit] MUST-FIX `check-phase-review-receipt.js` exits 0 after re-deriving `FIX-THEN-SHIP`; the E2E test explicitly blesses a verified Critical receipt, so the exit-code phase gate advances with a confirmed blocker. Exit nonzero unless the recomputed verdict is `SHIP-AS-IS`, and use a clean verdict for the positive E2E case.
🔴 [canonical-chain-bypass] MUST-FIX Mode A checks only the first base from canonical `chain.json`, then trusts `receipt.chain` for finalized statuses and disposition digests; a forged receipt can convert a pending generation into a passing finalized claim. Validate using `chainOnDisk` and require the receipt’s chain to match it exactly.
🔴 [artifact-validation-fail-open] MUST-FIX Mode A coerces malformed findings/dispositions to empty arrays, accepts duplicate IDs and invalid dispositions, and permits a missing/mistyped `open_findings`; Mode B likewise accepts empty or duplicate IDs. This can erase a verified Critical during re-derivation. Apply the same strict, unique-ID, exact-ID-set, enum, and required-field validation used by `finalize`.
🟠 [cross-generation-format-drift] MUST-FIX `finalize` closes earlier findings by absence and emits the latest generation’s verdict, while the checker unions every historical verified Critical/Major/Minor and ignores `closed_findings`; any repaired multi-generation review remains permanently unpassable. Re-derive the final receipt using the producer’s closure/latest-generation semantics.
🟠 [generation-artifacts-reusable] MUST-FIX `collect` permits reuse of aborted and `pending-with-gap` generations, overwrites existing generation files, leaves gap failures as reusable orphan artifacts, and `saveChainEntry` resets a concurrently malformed chain to `[]`. Refuse every reused generation/artifact, fail closed on chain corruption, and use exclusive creation for immutable generation files.
🔴 [review-result-shape-gap] MUST-FIX A dispatcher result with `status:"reviewed"` and `verdict:null`, missing/non-string findings, or `FIX-THEN-SHIP` with empty findings is accepted; the latter finalizes as `SHIP-AS-IS`, silently losing a reviewer blocker. Enforce status/verdict consistency, require a findings string, and require at least one parsed finding for `FIX-THEN-SHIP`.
🟠 [optout-source-self-claim] MUST-FIX Opt-out checking only requires resolver provenance to equal the receipt’s claim, not `off`, and hashes any receipt-selected existing file rather than the resolver’s actual `config_path`; a forged/stale opt-out can therefore pass with matching invented provenance and an unrelated file. Re-derive and require knob=`off`, resolved-from=`off`, and the exact resolver-selected config path and digest.
🟠 [auto-transition-not-expanded] MUST-FIX `hetero_review:auto` merely observes that `reviewer_ladder` is nonempty and labels the result `topology` while leaving the effective reviewer/QC seats unchanged; plan auto also treats an incomplete object such as `{}` as a valid topology seat. Populate the seats actually consumed by the review loop from validated complete tuples, otherwise use the specified native fallback and warning.
🟠 [consult-alias-exclusion] MUST-FIX QC-side engine aliases are normalized while topology ladder engines are not, so an aliased QC seat can be selected again as the consult seat, violating mandatory exclusion and decorrelation. Canonicalize engine and runner aliases on both sides and restore an aliased regression fixture.
🟠 [plan-panel-selection-contract] MUST-FIX Panel construction ignores the scorecard’s authoritative `family` and infers from engine substrings, while choosing the chair only from reviewer rows even when a consult candidate has higher effort; valid distinct-family seats can be collapsed as `unknown`, and the chair need not be highest effort. Preserve recorded family with inference only as fallback and select the chair from the full eligible candidate pool.
🟡 [topology-role-enum] MUST-FIX `--role` values are accumulated without validation, so unknown roles silently succeed with a partial metadata-only topology despite the frozen role enum. Reject any role outside the five declared values with a usage error.
🟠 [consult-hermetic-false-green] MUST-FIX `dispatch-consult-hermetic.test.sh` never invokes `dispatch-consult.sh`, deliberately avoids the alias case, and checks only the ubiquitous text `consult_dispatch` rather than the warning array; it passes if the consult rail or native-fallback warning is deleted. Invoke the production wrapper through hermetic shims and assert the selected seat plus the exact `capability_warnings` entry.
